skills.name: Common Denominator
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and convert fractions with different denominators into equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that already share a common denominator.

skills.name: Regrouping/Borrowing
skills.definition: Borrow one whole unit from the whole-number part and convert it into a fraction when the subtrahend's fraction exceeds the minuend's fraction.

skills.name: Whole Number Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number parts of the minuend and subtrahend in a mixed-number subtraction problem.

skills.name: Improper Fraction Conversion
skills.definition: Convert an improper fraction within a mixed number into a whole number plus a proper fraction before performing subtraction.
